# Openrefs

> 330 hand-picked, well-designed websites, curated into one free collection of design references. Each site has a full home-page capture, up to three tagged inner pages, style tags, measured facts (fonts, colours, platform) and a plain-words design note in Markdown.

## Data for agents

- Full dump (all live sites, one JSON file, refreshed daily): https://ref-index.vercel.app/references.json
  Download it once and filter locally. Shape: `{ generated, count, items: [...] }`.
- Search API (paged, 120 per page): https://ref-index.vercel.app/showcase.json?q=dark+minimal&style=dark,minimal&category=portfolio&view=all&offset=0
  Parameters: `q` (free text), `style` (comma list of tags below), `category` (one topic id), `medium` (all, web, 3d, mobile), `view` (`top` = staff picks, `all` = every live site), `offset`.
- Page screenshots by type (paged, 100 per page): https://ref-index.vercel.app/pages.json?type=pricing&pattern=big-type&offset=0
  Parameters: `type` (page type below), `pattern` (one pattern below), `offset`. Returns `{ items, total }`; each item has `type`, `patterns`, `title`, `url` (the page on the live site), `imageUrl` and `site` ({ id, name, url }). Human version: https://ref-index.vercel.app/pages
- Design note per site, as Markdown (palette, type, layout, motion, what makes it good, plus its tagged pages with image links): https://ref-index.vercel.app/site/{id}.md
- All design notes in one Markdown file: https://ref-index.vercel.app/designs.md
- All design notes as a zip, one file per site: https://ref-index.vercel.app/designs.zip
- One human page per site: https://ref-index.vercel.app/site/{id}

## Item fields (references.json)

- `id`, `name`, `url` (the live site), `page` (its Openrefs page), `image` (screenshot of the first screen, WebP, 1280x800; may be the site's share image instead)
- `medium`: web, 3d, ios, android or mobile
- `styles`: tags from the lists below (up to 2 look, 2 layout, 3 colour; every tagged site has `dark` or `light`)
- `categories`: topic ids, e.g. portfolio, agency, product, shop, editorial, event, ui-kit, design-tools, ai, finance, web3, dev, health, food, fashion, space, travel, culture, education, impact
- `staff_pick`: true for the hand-picked best-of
- `pages`: tagged page screenshots, home page first: `{ type, patterns, title, url, image }` (images are WebP, 1280 wide; the home page is a full-page capture)
- `design`: link to the site's Markdown design note (`/site/{id}.md`)
- `facts`: measured from the live site: `description`, `lang`, `fonts` (`heading`, `body`, `loaded`), `palette` (dominant colours of the home page as hex, biggest first), `built_with` (platform and libraries detected)

## Style tags

- Look: minimal, bold, brutalist, editorial, playful, retro, futuristic, luxury, corporate, organic, illustrated, immersive
- Layout: grid, bento, asymmetric, centered, split, full-bleed, sidebar, horizontal
- Colour: dark, light, monochrome, pastel, vibrant, neon, earthy, gradient, red, orange, green, blue, purple, pink

Tags were assigned by looking at screenshots, so they are good for filtering but not perfect. A few dozen sites have no `styles` yet.

## Page types and patterns

- Page types: home, about, work-index, case-study, pricing, features, services, shop, product-detail, blog-index, article, team, careers, contact, menu, event, gallery, collection, other
- Patterns (0-3 per page, home pages included): hero-video, big-type, grid, horizontal-scroll, sticky-nav, split-screen, marquee, full-bleed-image, carousel, editorial-layout, dark-mode, illustration, 3d-webgl, minimal

Page types and patterns were assigned by looking at screenshots, so expect a few misfiles. The design notes are first-pass: written from screenshots plus the measured facts, so a few details (especially colours read by eye, marked "approximate") may be off.

## Notes

- Free to read. Please keep requests modest; prefer the one-file dump over crawling pages.
- Screenshots belong to the sites they show. Link back to `url` when you cite a reference.
